metadata.question: Was there snow present in the Northern Tablelands in New South Wales, Australia on August 2, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily snow cover (MODIS/061/MOD10A1 Terra and MODIS/061/MYD10A1 Aqua) over a polygon approximating the Northern Tablelands, NSW, for 2025-08-02 to 2025-08-03. If no images, expand to ±1 day. If still empty, fallback to Sentinel-2 L2A SCL snow class within ±1 day. 2. Masking strategy: For MODIS, mask NDSI_Snow_Cover to valid 0–100 and count snow where >0. For Sentinel-2, treat SCL==11 as snow; use SCL presence for valid pixel count (no extra cloud mask). 3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If collections empty after fallbacks → C1. If valid pixel count = 0 after masking → C2. If reduce results are null/NaN → C3. Otherwise, snow present if any snow pixels > 0 → A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { function eeGet(obj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); } // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [149.8, -28.7], [153.1, -28.7], [153.1, -31.9], [149.8, -31.9], [149.8, -28.7] ]); function dateAdd(d, days) { const dt = new Date(d + 'T00:00:00Z'); dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + days); return dt.toISOString().slice(0, 10); } const baseStart = '2025-08-02'; const baseEnd = '2025-08-03'; // end-exclusive const attempts = [ {start: baseStart, end: baseEnd, label: 'D0'}, {start: dateAdd(baseStart, -1), end: dateAdd(baseEnd, 1), label: 'D±1'} ]; let finalTag = null; let printed = false; try { console.log('Region: Northern Tablelands, NSW, Australia'); let usedDataset = null; // Try MODIS Terra+Aqua first, with two date windows for (const at of attempts) { const terraCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate(at.start, at.end) .filterBounds(region); const aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1') .filterDate(at.start, at.end) .filterBounds(region); const terraSize = await eeGet(terraCol.size()); const aquaSize = await eeGet(aquaCol.size()); console.log(`MODIS Window ${at.label}: ${at.start} to ${at.end}`); console.log(`Terra imgs: ${terraSize}, Aqua imgs: ${aquaSize}`); const totalSize = (terraSize || 0) + (aquaSize || 0); if (totalSize === 0) { continue; // try next window or fallback } const col = terraCol.merge(aquaCol) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover') .map(function(img) { const ndsi = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const valid = ndsi.gte(0).and(ndsi.lte(100)); return ndsi.updateMask(valid); }); const mergedMax = col.max().rename('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); // Valid pixel count (unmasked) const validDict = await eeGet( mergedMax.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) ); const validCount = validDict ? validDict['NDSI_Snow_Cover'] : null; // Snow pixel count (>0) const snowBinary = mergedMax.gt(0).selfMask().rename('snow'); const snowDict = await eeGet( snowBinary.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) ); const snowCount = snowDict ? snowDict['snow'] : null; if ( validCount === null || snowCount === null || isNaN(validCount) || isNaN(snowCount) ) { console.log('MODIS reduceRegion produced null/NaN.'); finalTag = 'C3'; printed = true; break; } console.log(`Valid px: ${validCount}`); console.log(`Snow px: ${snowCount} (${validCount > 0 ? (100 * snowCount / validCount).toFixed(2) : '0.00'}%)`); if (validCount === 0) { console.log('No valid MODIS pixels after masking.'); finalTag = 'C2'; printed = true; break; } usedDataset = 'MODIS'; finalTag = (snowCount > 0) ? 'A' : 'B'; printed = true; break; } // Fallback to Sentinel-2 if still undecided due to empty MODIS if (!printed && finalTag === null) { // Check if MODIS was truly empty across attempts // We'll try S2 within ±1 day const s2Start = dateAdd(baseStart, -1); const s2End = dateAdd(baseEnd, 1); const s2col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(s2Start, s2End) .filterBounds(region); const s2size = await eeGet(s2col.size()); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Window D±1: ${s2Start} to ${s2End}`); console.log(`S2 imgs: ${s2size}`); if (!s2size || s2size === 0) { finalTag = 'C1'; printed = true; } else { // Mosaic SCL snow class const sclSnow = s2col.select('SCL').map(function(img) { return img.select('SCL').eq(11).rename('snow'); }).max().rename('snow'); // Valid pixels: where SCL is defined (count SCL across mosaic of max SCL presence) const sclAny = s2col.select('SCL').max().rename('SCL'); const validDictS2 = await eeGet( sclAny.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) ); const snowDictS2 = await eeGet( sclSnow.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) ); const validS2 = validDictS2 ? validDictS2['SCL'] : null; const snowS2 = snowDictS2 ? snowDictS2['snow'] : null; if ( validS2 === null || snowS2 === null || isNaN(validS2) || isNaN(snowS2) ) { console.log('S2 reduceRegion produced null/NaN.'); finalTag = 'C3'; printed = true; } else if (validS2 === 0) { console.log('No valid S2 pixels.'); finalTag = 'C2'; printed = true; } else { console.log(`Valid px (S2): ${validS2}`); console.log(`Snow px (S2): ${snowS2} (${(100 * snowS2 / validS2).toFixed(2)}%)`); usedDataset = 'S2'; finalTag = (snowS2 > 0) ? 'A' : 'B'; printed = true; } } } if (!finalTag) { // If we reach here without a decision, treat as calculation failure finalTag = 'C3'; } console.log(finalTag); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
